decisions.statement: A reading is carried in by POST.
A request by any other method is refused rather than answered.
A carrier presenting no relay secret is refused.
The secret is read off the environment rather than off a page.
A body that is not a whole reading is refused rather than held.
The reading carried in is written beside the readout's own page.
A reading that was not written is answered as a fault rather than as carried.
The answer to a reading not written says why that reading was not written.
The answer names the readout and the moment the reading was taken.
Nothing between the carrier and this route keeps an answer.

definition: the reading a workstation carries in for a readout
